scripts.dev: pnpm run models:build && tsx watch src/server.ts
scripts.dev:local: OPENWORK_DEV_MODE=1 pnpm run models:build && OPENWORK_DEV_MODE=1 PORT=${GATEWAY_PORT-${INFERENCE_PORT:-8791}} tsx watch src/server.ts
scripts.test:governance: NODE_OPTIONS=--conditions=development tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 test/governance*.test.ts test/gateway.test.ts test/proxy.test.ts test/rollups.test.ts
scripts.test:usage-limits: NODE_OPTIONS=--conditions=development tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 test/gateway.test.ts test/request-log.test.ts test/pricing.test.ts test/usage-completeness.test.ts test/usage-openai-chat.test.ts test/usage-protocols.test.ts test/usage-bedrock-converse.test.ts test/usage-preflight.test.ts
scripts.test:usage-limits:db: DEN_USAGE_TEST_DATABASE_URL=${DEN_USAGE_TEST_DATABASE_URL:?Set an isolated loopback usage_limits_test database URL} NODE_OPTIONS=--conditions=development tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 test/usage-limits-db.test.ts
scripts.typecheck:governance: tsc --noEmit --allowImportingTsExtensions --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --strict --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --resolveJsonModule --pretty false test/governance*.test.ts test/gateway.test.ts test/rollups.test.ts
